title: Dethlac Ant Killer Spray 2 x 250ml | Kills Ants, Woodlice, Cockroaches & Crawling Insects | Insect Killer Indoor & Outdoor Use | Invisible Weatherproof Lacquer Barrier | Trusted Since 1959
bullet_points: The Original Dethlac Ant Killer Spray – Since 1959, Dethlac has been delivering powerful results. It forms a tough, invisible lacquer that creates a long-lasting barrier to crawling insects. You won’t see it, but the results speak for themselves. Invisible barrier. Visible results!

Eliminate Crawling Insects Effectively - Dethlac Spray targets Ants, Woodlice, Cockroaches, Silverfish, and other crawling insects with a powerful lacquerer-based formula, creating a long-lasting residual barrier to prevent and kill crawling insects within a few hours of coming into contact with the treated surface. Perfect for use along insect trails, entry points, and nesting areas for effective ant control.

Indoor & Outdoor Protection – Our Insecticide spray is pet safe and effective for use in homes, gardens, garages, sheds, patios, and other common trouble spots. Whether indoors or out, it provides a reliable barrier wherever crawling insects are found!

Weatherproof Barrier – Dethlac ant spray invisible lacquer keeps working through rain, mopping and heavy foot traffic, delivering months of protection from a single application. Ideal for outdoor surfaces and high-traffic areas, spray once, stay protected.

Pinpoint Accuracy, Zero Mess – The precision aerosol nozzle targets skirting boards, door frames, windowsills and tight crevices exactly where ants enter, with no drips or over spray. Apply quickly and confidently in any room.

Trusted for Over 60 Years – A trusted household name since 1959, Dethlac has been a go-to solution for generations, providing effective pest control and peace of mind to homeowners worldwide. Depend on Dethlac to keep your home pest-free, year after year.
